children: Airtasker's bears at Morgan Stanley see potential for the services-marketplace operator to miss consensus forecasts due to Australia's weak economic backdrop. The investment bank's analysts tell clients in a note that they remain positive on Airtasker's core Australia business, citing its strong brand and enduring customer base. However, they see potential for softer consumer spending to weigh on demand. MS ceases coverage of Airtasker with an underweight recommendation on the stock, pointing to factors including slowing revenue growth and unprofitable offshore expansion. MS cuts its target price 25% to 0.15 Australian dollars. Shares are up 2.6% at A$0.195. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
